author: potuz
content: Thanks for it! Just a comment here rather than in the PR, and cc <@592004585506340885> cause I know we diverge here. I believe the spec should not have such long comments on Python functions. I am pretty much convinced this is Claude creeping into the spec. It just distracts the reader and makes the code's cognitive cost higher for little reason. Just my personal preference, I wonder how others think about code comments.
